title: POST /v1/config response
description: Carries ONE document: the org's served config. A response the client cannot parse or execute is refused whole and the cached config keeps collecting.

config.description: The served YAML document, standard base64 (a Go []byte). The stored bytes are served verbatim and cached verbatim.

expires_at.description: When this document goes stale (server clock + CP_CONFIG_TTL). Expiry fails toward collecting: the client keeps running on the cached config and stamps config_expired rather than halting, because source stores are reaped on their own schedules and a halted client loses data permanently.
